title: withPapyrus should include corpora/ and publication files in the Next output file tracing so SSR reads work on Amplify compute
description: next.31 `withPapyrus` sets no `outputFileTracingIncludes`. On Amplify compute, p.apyr.us `/information` 500s with ENOENT /tmp/app/corpora/papyrus-newsroom-sections.yml because the repo `corpora/*.yml` files read at runtime via fs are not traced into the compute bundle. Fix in the Papyrus next.config helper (packages/papyrus/src/next*) so every publication gets the tracing include by default (corpora/** and other runtime-read publication files), with tests. QUEUED behind the red develop (Cyclotron PR #167-#170 broke Release: see PPY discussion); do NOT implement now. Interim fix lives in the AnthusAI/p.apyr.us scaffold (see PPY-aa93b3).

comments.author: home
comments.text: Fixed in PR #180 (squash b46d3157675ee0ef2b7fa567a38c7c4a977396e1), released as 1.0.0-next.35. withPapyrus now merges outputFileTracingIncludes["/**"] with ./corpora/**/* and ./amplify_outputs.json; unit test test:with-papyrus-tracing is in test:ci:ts. The p.apyr.us scaffold setting is no longer needed.

right_now_summary: Fixed in PR #180 and released in next.35 with tracing for corpora and publication files.
